training_only_targets: QM optimized-minimum heavy-atom Cartesian geometry after proper rotation
existing normalized training force and Hessian response
positive projected MM curvature at the QM minimum

optimize: harmonic r and theta linear equilibrium coefficients

decision_rule: Apply the curvature scales in order, seeding each stage from the preceding result, and stop at the first stage satisfying the unchanged geometry and projected-curvature checks. This policy may create a gate-neutral refinement candidate only. Held-out response, relative energies, nonbonded validation, topology, NAMD, and DNA-context gates remain independent and mandatory.
